headline: Exploited VMware vCenter and Cisco Expressway flaws reach their CISA deadline today
plain_summary: Google says a suspected state-backed group has exploited a flaw in VMware vCenter since September, and a Cisco Expressway flaw is also being exploited; both carry CISA deadlines of 23 November. Apache says its Roller software is under attack too. A French hospital in Guadeloupe lost all its data to encryption, and a US medical supplier says 1,326,066 people were affected by a breach. Anyone running these products should patch now.

items.title: Google: ARMORY CASTLE exploits VMware vCenter zero-day CVE-2026-123890
items.why: Google says the suspected PRC-nexus actor has exploited this unauthenticated bypass since early September 2026.
items.action: Apply Broadcom's patches immediately (8.0 U3m, 9.0.2.0200, 9.1.1.0200; 7.0 has no public patch) and restrict inbound access to and egress from vCenter.

items.title: Cisco Expressway flaw CVE-2026-76466 exploited after public PoC
items.why: Cisco rates it 9.8, and CISA added it to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on 20 November.
items.action: Upgrade clustered Expressway to X15.5.20 or later now; if you cannot, restrict TCP 4371-4372 to trusted cluster node IPs.

items.title: Apache warns Roller RCE flaw CVE-2026-129448 is exploited
items.why: Apache says the unauthenticated XML-RPC flaw affects Roller 4.0.0 through 6.1.4, and Italy's CSIRT reported active exploitation.
items.action: Upgrade Roller to 6.1.6 or later; if you cannot, set enabledForExtensions to false in WEB-INF/web.xml or remove the /roller-services/xmlrpc mapping, then restart.

items.title: HKCERT: F5 BIG-IP flaw CVE-2026-126714 has public proof-of-concept
items.why: HKCERT rates it high risk and says public exploit code lets an authenticated attacker run system commands.
items.action: Apply the workarounds in F5 advisory K000164320 for BIG-IP 17.1.0-17.1.3, 17.5.0-17.5.1 and 21.1.0.

items.title: CHU de Guadeloupe hit by cyberattack; care postponed
items.why: La 1ère reports all hospital data was encrypted and no ransom demand had been received.
items.action: Call the emergency medical line before going to the hospital, as SAMU doctor Patrick Portecop advises; urgent care continues.

items.title: Prism Medical Products breach affects 1,326,066 people, Oregon filing says
items.why: The breach notice confirms suspicious network activity on 19 October; data includes Social Security and medical details for some people.
items.action: Prism is mailing notices and offering 24 months of credit and dark web monitoring, per HIPAA Journal.

items.title: FCC proposes three-year renewals for Cyber Trust Mark products
items.why: Manufacturers would have to renew security certifications every three years, with comments due 23 December.

items.title: Luxembourg hospital CHdN suffers computer outage
items.why: The hospital says nothing currently points to a cyberattack; a fibre fault is the favoured explanation, so a cyber cause is not confirmed.
